broker.name: Fxview
broker.tagline: Its site names 4 regulators, including FSCA, FSC (Mauritius), and CySEC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: The Fxview pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include RAW ECN, Premium ECN, Islamic, and Zero Commission. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, ActTrader, ZuluTrade, and Fxview app. The site names these regulators: FSCA, FSC (Mauritius), CySEC, and SEBI. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSCA: Finvasia Capital (Pty) Ltd, 50410. FSC (Mauritius): Finvasia Capital Ltd, IK21000018. CySEC: Charlgate Limited, 367/18. SEBI: Finvasia Securities Private Limited, INZ000176037.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, group licences, about, leverage and download center fetched. The same licences page lists MiFID II passport notification numbers, including UK FCA 850138, Germany BaFin 157125, France ACPR 85051, Italy CONSOB 5151, Spain CNMV 4892, Sweden FI 56650, Hungary MNB K8805342 and Norway Finanstilsynet FT00118545, plus other EEA authorities without numbers. Those are not entered as separate home licences. SEBI entry is the group Indian broker licence on that page. Download center confirms MT4, MT5 and ActTrader. Homepage also names ZuluTrade and the Fxview app.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: Group licences page names Finvasia Capital (Pty) Ltd for South Africa, Finvasia Capital Ltd for Mauritius, Charlgate Limited for Cyprus, and Finvasia Securities Private Limited for India. No single headquarters address was stated. About page says Finvasia Group was established in 2009 in Canada and India. That year is the group, not a stated Fxview founding year.
